en.headline: Four hurt in early morning fire at Shui Chuen O Estate
en.dek: Firefighters put out a blaze in a Yan Chuen House flat in Sha Tin shortly after 7am; a family of four was injured and about 140 residents left the block.
body: A fire broke out in a flat at Yan Chuen House, Shui Chuen O Estate in Sha Tin just after 6am on Wednesday, and four people from the same household were injured, local media reported, citing police and fire officers at the scene.

Multiple residents reported smoke coming from the unit. Firefighters extinguished the blaze at about 7.10am. Early accounts said a sofa in the living room had caught fire and that the windows of the flat were blackened. The Fire Services Department was investigating the cause.

The injured were described as two parents and two children. They left the flat with two cats. About 140 residents of the block went downstairs to wait while crews worked, according to later local reports; earlier figures put the number who left at about 60.
No official casualty severity or cause had been confirmed by mid-morning. Police and fire officers remained at the Sha Tin estate as inquiries continued.

zh.headline: 沙田水泉澳邸欣泉樓火警 一家四口受傷
zh.dek: 周三早上六時許沙田水泉澳邸欣泉樓單位起火，消防七時十分救熄，一家四口受傷，約140名住客落樓暫避。
body: 沙田水泉澳邸欣泉樓一單位周三早上六時許起火，本地傳媒引述現場警員及消防人員報道，同一住戶一家四口受傷。
多名住客報稱單位冒煙。消防到場灌救，約七時十分將火救熄。初步消息指客廳梳化着火，單位窗戶熏黑。消防處正調查起火原因。
傷者為父母及一子一女，逃離時帶同兩隻貓。較後報道指約140名住客自行落樓暫避，較早前則有報道指約60人疏散。
至上午仍未有官方公布傷勢或起火原因。警員及消防人員繼續在屋邸調查。
